countingConvention.interpretation: Heuristic set-accounting weights, not measured growth/stimulus ratios or person-specific coefficients.
countingConvention.aggregation: One completed set gives each listed muscle its coefficient. If several source labels are merged into one display group, take the maximum for that set, never sum overlapping labels.
countingConvention.review: Every row requires review before any production enablement. A missing/null mapping must display as unclassified/excluded, never silently count as zero.
